content.text: Not quite — removing it from `AddCommand` would make it completely unavailable. To keep it functional but hidden from `entire help`, set `Hidden: true` on the cobra command.
Just add `Hidden: true` to the command definition:

input.old_string:
cmd := &cobra.Command{
		Use:   "migrate",
		Short: "Migrate Entire data to newer formats",
		Long:  `Migrate Entire data to newer formats. Currently supports migrating v1 checkpoints to v2.`,

		Use:    "migrate",
		Short:  "Migrate Entire data to newer formats",
		Long:   `Migrate Entire data to newer formats. Currently supports migrating v1 checkpoints to v2.`,
		Hidden: true,
